sources.title: SQLite backup overview
sources.independent_operation: Opened governing primary context; any listed code/tests inspected statically, never executed.
sources.assessed_facts: Completed API snapshot; external writes can restart it; repeated restarts can prevent completion. Database copy does not capture unrelated files.
sources.limits: Conditional examples; no product dependency or future application result established.

sources.title: SQLite C backup API
sources.independent_operation: Opened governing primary context; any listed code/tests inspected statically, never executed.
sources.assessed_facts: BUSY/LOCKED retry; IOERR/NOMEM/READONLY fatal; destination handle excluded from other uses. Finish without DONE can return OK after rollback; completion must be distinguished.
sources.limits: Conditional examples; no product dependency or future application result established.

sources.title: SQLite WAL
sources.independent_operation: Opened governing primary context; any listed code/tests inspected statically, never executed.
sources.assessed_facts: WAL carries committed state. Reset race requires concurrent connections writing/checkpointing; fixed 3.51.3+, backports 3.44.6/3.50.7. Not a claim that backup alone triggers it.
sources.limits: Conditional examples; no product dependency or future application result established.
